label: Priority f equals g plus h
section: Priority f equals g plus h
subgoals: Take g as the shortest-route cost from the source
Take h as the Manhattan distance to the target
Order the open list by f = g + h

label: Cells A* must expand
subgoals: Compute f for each reachable cell from its shortest distance and its heuristic
Count the cells with f strictly below the best cost
Compare with the Lee count of cells with g below the best cost

label: Heuristics with real costs
subgoals: Scale the heuristic by the cheapest step cost and add unavoidable via costs
Keep the heuristic admissible to preserve optimality
Seed several sources and use the nearest target for multi-terminal search
